brief:
An Israeli official disclosed that confidential communications have taken place between Israel and Turkey aimed at preventing friction in Syria, the Ma'an news agency reported. The talks represent an effort by both countries to manage their competing interests and military operations across Syrian territory.

The revelation suggests diplomatic channels remain active between Jerusalem and Ankara despite broader tensions between the two nations. Israeli-Turkish relations have faced strain in recent years over Gaza policy and regional disagreements. The specific areas of concern addressed in the secret contacts were not disclosed by the Israeli official.
title: Israeli official reveals secret talks with Turkey over Syria tensions
